readBurnInk

Resolves the burn palette from the root CSS custom properties — dark theme publishes a cyan-blue plasma ramp, light theme an airy paper-fire ramp. Falls back to the fixed canvas inks when the properties are absent (older stylesheet, non-themed host).

  • @returns The combustion ink ramp (embers ×3, scorch, smoke).

(module scope)

Word box for DOM-faithful rasterization — the word's position inside the title element in CSS px (y is the word fragment's bottom edge; the caller subtracts the descent to land on the baseline).

text

The raw (pre-transform) word as it appears in the text node.

x

Left edge of the word fragment relative to the title box.

y

Bottom edge of the word fragment relative to the title box.

titleWordBoxes

Reads each word's rendered box straight from the DOM via Range rects — the browser's own line-breaking is the wrap authority. Canvas measureText metrics drift sub-pixel from the layout engine (letter-spacing accumulation, shaping/hinting differences): the drift used to push the wrap loop a word early, the extra line drew ABOVE the bottom-anchored paper's top edge, and the visible title collapsed to its last word — burning only that fragment (the "title cut to its last word" bug). Positioning each word at its DOM fragment makes phantom wraps impossible and also reproduces justified/aligned spacing for free. Returns null when the API or a usable text node is absent.

  • @param title The h2 element holding the title text.
  • @returns Per-word boxes in title-relative CSS px, or null to fall back.

rasterizeTitle

Rasterizes the h2 text into the paper canvas. Words are drawn at their DOM Range fragment positions (see {@link titleWordBoxes}), so the raster is pixel-faithful to the rendered title — same wraps, same spacing. Engines without Range fall back to a measured word-pack matching the DOM box, drawn bottom-anchored like the overlay's align-items: flex-end.

cssW/cssH are the title box in CSS px while the paper's backing store is device px (cssW × dpr): canvas font and measureText units are CSS px, so the context is scaled cssW→paper.width first — without the transform the glyphs land at 1/dpr size on hidpi/fractional displays (the "burn text renders smaller than the title" bug).

  • @param title The h2 element whose glyphs are re-rendered.
  • @param paper Offscreen canvas sized in device px.
  • @param cssW Title box width in CSS px.
  • @param cssH Title box height in CSS px.
  • @param ink Pre-capture resolved ink color.

analyzePaper

Reads the rasterized paper's alpha channel to locate each glyph: columns that carry ink form runs — a space leaves a transparent gap, so each contiguous run IS one letter (kerned pairs may fuse, which just makes them burn as a unit). Builds:

  • colInk: 1 where a paper-x column has any glyph pixel — ember spawning and the char band use it so nothing glows in the spaces.
  • letters: per-run ink bounds (x0..x1, y0..y1) plus a random burn speed and ignition delay. Speeds spread 0.55..1.45×, delays up to 22% of total progress — letters catch at different moments and burn at different paces.
  • colLetter: paper-x → owning letter index; gap columns bind to the nearest run so the erase polygon stays coherent across spaces.

Finally every letter's speed is normalized so the SLOWEST ignitor finishes at ~98% progress — the burn ends with the description's typing, never after.

  • @param s The live session — fills letters/colInk/colLetter + work size.

syncPaper

Anchors the canvas once at arm size, then tracks POSITION only. The card's expand ease animates the h2's cqw font-size for ~0.42s after hover; re-measuring the box every step baked that shrink into the raster, so the burning glyphs visibly collapsed with the DOM font (the reported font-reduction bug). Freezing the raster keeps the title the size it was when it caught fire — only the canvas slides along the moving box. lastBox/lastPos signatures skip all work when nothing moved.

  • @param s The live session — owns the canvases and DOM elements.
